title: Close the leaked DeviceRegistryDatabase in signup_screen_test.dart's createTestWidgetWithDatabase helper
why: createTestWidgetWithDatabase creates a fresh in-memory DeviceRegistryDatabase on every call (3 call sites: lines 205, 247, 395) but never closes it, unlike the sibling UserDatabase two lines away that IS correctly torn down via addTearDown. Each leaked Drift NativeDatabase leaves a dangling native sqlite3 resource for the life of the test process; the file's own driftRuntimeOptions.dontWarnAboutMultipleDatabases = true suppresses the warning class of symptom this would otherwise surface.
recommendation: Add addTearDown(() async => testRegistry.close()); immediately after constructing testRegistry inside createTestWidgetWithDatabase.
acceptance_criteria: every DeviceRegistryDatabase created in signup_screen_test.dart is closed via addTearDown

corrections: Rule cite is imprecise: TQ-6 covers hermeticity (wall-clock/randomness/shared state), not resource cleanup per se; no exact-fit rule ID exists, but finding is valid as general test-hygiene per digest's 'include the small stuff.'
